2/ Types of Altcoins (The Crypto Zoo)

🔹 "FBI can’t find me" – Monero, Zcash  
🔹 "Doge to the moon?" – Dogecoin, Shiba Inu. https://t.co/SHKFGWooML

1/ WTF is an Altcoin?**  
Altcoin = Bitcoin’s weird younger siblings.  (Any Crypto other than Bitcoin)
Some are genius (Ethereum), some are memes (Dogecoin), and some are outright scams (*cough* Bitconnect).  
Let’s dive into this circus. 🎪 #Crypto  #Altcoins https://t.co/SuAG4XuQAx
